g.text: P125 — Whole-job cost, outcomes and mechanism use
All 4 development tasks × both fixed policies; one seed; common single checkpoint
All model roles, summaries, failures and recovery are included in logical tokens. API requests and partial hits are separate counts, not tokens.
Partial hits do not equal net backend savings: later full reads and ordinary cache reuse can offset them.
Cheap failures do not establish quality-preserving savings. These development runs give no general quality or novelty guarantee.
Audited adoption gate: False. Audit errors: 0. All conditions are retained, including incomplete and unevaluated conditions.
